verdict.rationale: Supermemory's container-tag model provides hard-boundary namespacing per user/tenant while its 'spaces' concept and MCP shared memory layer explicitly let teams collaborate on shared context ('space keeps a team's documents, memories, and profile context focused' and 'shared memory layer... same authorized context'), directly matching the ask for team/group memory alongside private per-user memory. Missing for 10: explicit role-based access control details for who can join/write to a shared space, and independent/hands-on confirmation of cross-agent shared-space behavior beyond vendor docs.
